About this initiative
Summary
In line with the Clean Industrial Deal objective to use energy more efficiently, this initiative – together with the related Ecodesign Regulation – seeks to ensure that servers for the EU market evolve towards higher energy efficiency and performance levels. Labelling rules will also ensure better user information regarding the products’ efficiency and performance.
Topic
Single market
Type of act
